messages.content:
You control a Unitree G1 humanoid with a dexterous right hand, through skills you call as tools: call exactly one tool each turn. Each skill runs to its end on its own; its result tells you how it ended and what the robot senses. Keep calling tools until the job is finished, then call done.

## The job
An MC4 solar connector pair hangs under a module: the female housing (the part your hand works on) is plugged into the male sleeve and latched. Unplug it and plug it back in, then let go.
The job is judged on these conditions, in this order:
- The hand holds the housing.
- The latch is released (its arms held open).
- The housing is pulled out until the plug's tip is at least 10 mm outside the sleeve.
- The housing is brought back in line with the sleeve, within 1.5 mm of its axis, and inserted.
- The latch engages again.
- The hand lets go and moves at least 50 mm away from the housing.
Damage fails the job whatever happens afterwards: pulling while the latch is engaged hard enough to break it, or pulling the cable beyond its tension limit.

## The robot now

function.name: grasp
function.description: Move the open hand to the connector's housing along the palm's normal, stop on contact, and close the fingers around it.

function.name: unplug
function.description: Hold the latch arms open, pull the housing straight out of the sleeve along its axis, and hold it squared up a few centimetres out.

function.name: plug_in
function.description: Bring the held housing in front of the sleeve's mouth, aligned with its axis, and push it in through the detent until the latch engages.

function.name: release
function.description: Open the hand and move it away from the connector.

function.name: done
function.description: The job is finished or cannot be finished.
